attribution.title: The Holy Bible, King James Version (1769 Blayney edition)
attribution.creator: Public domain text; digital edition via scrollmapper/bible_databases
attribution.citation: Text: King James Version, 1769 Blayney revision, public domain. Identification of persons: Wikidata (CC0 1.0), queried for biblical figures.
modifications: Built a character network from the text: two people are tied when a verse names both.
Identified persons from Wikidata rather than from the text, so that places, peoples, and titles are never nodes.
Resolved shared names to the most prominent claimant, and dropped those too close to call.
Blocked tribal and territorial eponyms, which name a people far more often than a person.
Dropped ties weaker than 1 and characters with fewer than 2 ties, then kept the largest connected component (1024 nodes and 3190 ties in, 726 and 2987 out).
Added a normalised rank per tie endpoint so thickness reads relative to each character's own ties rather than raw counts.
Computed a force-directed layout for the full graph, used by the reveal animation.
